items.title: Storage Bins/Cabin, Galley, and Lavatory Storage Compartments/Closets

items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Procedures are established to secure the affected bin, compartment, or closet in the closed position,
b) Affected bin, compartment, or closet is prominently placarded "DO NOT USE",
c) Any emergency equipment located in affected bin, compartment, or closet is considered inoperative, and
d) Affected bin, compartment, or closet is not used for storage of any item(s) except for those permanently affixed.
NOTE 1: For overhead bins, if no partitions are installed, the entire overhead bin is considered inoperative.
NOTE 2: Proviso is not intended to preclude crewmember inspections.

May be inoperative provided:
a) For non-retractable doors, affected door is removed,
b) For retractable doors, affected door is removed or secured in the retracted (fully open) position,
c) Affected bin, compartment, or closet is not used for storage of any items except those permanently affixed,
d) Affected bin, compartment, or closet is prominently placarded "DO NOT USE",
e) Procedures are established and used to alert crewmembers and passengers of inoperative bins, compartments, or closets, and
f) Passengers are briefed that affected bin, compartment, or closet is not used.
NOTE 1: For overhead bins if no partitions are installed, entire overhead bin is considered inoperative.
NOTE 2: Any emergency equipment located in the affected bin, compartment or closet (permanently affixed) is available for use.

May be inoperative in closed position provided:
a) Affected bin, compartment, or closet is prominently placarded "DO NOT USE",
b) Any emergency equipment located in affected bin, compartment, or closet is considered inoperative, and
c) Location placarding for any emergency equipment stored in affected bin, compartment, or closet is removed or obscured.
NOTE: Use of this proviso may be dependent upon an operator's aircraft security program, as appropriate.

items.title: Multi Latch/ Quarter-Turn Lug Installations
items.rem:
One latch/lug per compartment may be inoperative provided:
a) Remaining latch(es)/lug(s) on affected compartments operates normally, and
b) If affected compartment is used for a galley cart, cart remains empty.

items.title: Storage Compartment Key Locks
items.rem: May be inoperative in the unlocked position provided doors can be secured by other means.

items.title: Beds (Electrical Operation) (Jet Aviation Engineering Services (JAES))
items.rem: May be inoperative provided manual override system operates normally.
May be inoperative provided manual override system operates normally.
May be inoperative provided seats at associated inoperative table are not occupied.

items.title: Crash Pads (Jet Aviation Engineering Services (JAES))
items.rem: May be inoperative or missing provided associated seat adjacent to crash pad is not occupied.

items.title: Cockpit Smoke Vision System (CSVS) (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER) (STC ST00892LA)
items.rem: May be inoperative or missing.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Barrier remains in retracted position, and
b) Alternate procedures are established and used.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Barrier is removed, and
b) Alternate procedures are established and used.
May be inoperative provided procedures do not require its use.

items.title: Security Kit and/or Associated Equipment
items.rem: May be inoperative, missing, or have missing equipment.

items.title: Engine and APU Fire Extinguisher Discharge Lights
Engine Overheat and Fire Detection Systems
Dual Loop
items.rem: Except for ER operations beyond 120 minutes, one loop (A or B) per engine may be inoperative provided remaining operative loops are verified to operate normally once each flight-day.

items.title: Portable Fire Extinguishers
items.rem:
Any in excess of those required by 14 CFR may be inoperative or removed provided:
a) Inoperative fire extinguisher remains in a certified location until removed from the aircraft at the next suitable maintenance facility,
b) Location placarding is removed or obscured, and
c) Required distribution is maintained.
NOTE: Inoperative fire extinguishers, removed from a certified location or removed from the aircraft, are subject to 49 CFR dangerous goods regulations.

items.title: Tamper Seals or Tags
items.rem: May be inoperative, damaged, or missing provided proper installation and servicing is verified at each preflight.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Wheel Well fire detection system is deactivated, and
b) Brake temperature monitoring system (BTMS) operates normally.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Wheel well fire detection system is deactivated,
b) Landing gear remain extended for ten minutes after takeoff, and
c) Appropriate performance adjustments are applied.
NOTE: In case of engine failure after V1, landing gear should be retracted until takeoff obstacles are cleared.

items.title: APU Fire Shutoff System
items.rem: Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided APU is not used.

items.title: APU Fire Extinguisher System
items.rem: Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided APU is not used.

items.title: Single and Dual Loop
items.rem: Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided APU is not used.

items.title: APU DET INOP Light
items.rem:
May be inoperative extinguished provided:
d) APU fire detection system operates normally, and
e) A fire warning test is performed before each APU start.

items.title: Dual Loop
items.rem: Except for ER operations beyond 120 minutes, one loop (A or B) may be inoperative.

items.title: External Warning Horn/Warning Light
items.rem: May be inoperative for ground operation provided flight deck APU Overheat/Fire Protection Panel is continuously monitored.

items.title: Engine/APU Fire Extinguisher Test System (EXT TEST) (Squib Test)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Failure is verified to be in squib test circuit.
b) Squib circuit is verified to operate normally once each flight-day.

items.title: APU Fire Extinguisher Squib Test Circuits (EXT TEST) (-300/-400/-500/-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided remaining APU Squib test circuit is verified to operate normally once each flight-day.

items.title: APU Squib Light
items.rem: Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided APU is not used.

items.title: Bell Cutout Switch (Overheat/Fire Protection Panel)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Bell cutout function of both Master Fire Warning lights operates normally, and
b) Fire Warning Bell operates normally.

items.title: Bell Cutout Function of Master Fire Warning Light
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Bell cutout function switch operates normally, and
b) Fire Warning Bell operates normally.

Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
c) Right pack and right engine bleed is used for pressurization only,
d) Use of APU is prohibited except for engine start,
e) Isolation valve and left engine bleed valve remain closed for all operations except engine start,
f) Airplane is not operated in known or forecast icing conditions, and
g) Flight altitude remains at or below FL 250.

Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) Left pack and left engine or APU bleed air is used for pressurization only,
b) Isolation valve and right engine bleed valve remain closed for all operations except engine start,
c) Airplane is not operated in known or forecast icing conditions, and
d) Flight altitude remains at or below FL 250.
For each lavatory, lavatory fire extinguisher system may be inoperative provided associated lavatory smoke detection system operates normally.

For each lavatory, lavatory fire extinguisher system may be inoperative provided:
a) Lavatory waste receptacle is empty,
b) Associated lavatory door is locked closed and placarded: "INOPERATIVE - DO NOT ENTER", and
c) Lavatory is used only by crewmembers.
NOTE: These provisions are not intended to prohibit lavatory use or inspection by crewmembers.

items.title: Passenger Configuration
items.rem:
For each lavatory, lavatory smoke detection system may be inoperative provided:
a) Lavatory waste receptacle is empty,
b) Associated lavatory door is locked closed and placarded: "INOPERATIVE - DO NOT ENTER", and
c) Lavatory is used only by crewmembers.
NOTE: These provisions are not intended to prohibit lavatory use or inspection by crewmembers.

items.title: Lavatory Smoke Detector SELF TEST Switch
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated lavatory smoke detector is verified to operate normally.

items.title: Lavatory Smoke Detector TEST Switch on Flight Attendant's Panel
items.rem: May be inoperative provided each lavatory smoke detector is verified to operate normally.

items.title: Flight Deck Test Feature
items.rem: May be inoperative provided system integrity is verified by an acceptable procedure once each flight-day.

items.title: Lower Cargo Compartment Fire Detection/Suppression Systems (All models and STCs)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided procedures are established and used to ensure associated compartment remains empty or is verified to contain only empty cargo handling equipment, ballast (ballast may be loaded in ULDs), and/or Fly Away Kits.
NOTE 1: Operator MELs must define which items are approved for inclusion in Fly Away Kits and which materials can be used as ballast.
NOTE 2: Class E cargo compartments require only installation of smoke or fire detection systems (not suppression).

items.title: Boeing installed system, STC ST00749LA-D, ST00763LA-D, ST01184LA, ST01674AT, ST01424LA, ST10153T, ST01804LA, ST01114WI Only
items.rem: One loop (A or B) in each compartment may be inoperative provided opposite loop is checked to operate normally.

items.title: STC ST00405LA-D Only
items.rem: May be inoperative provided one loop in each compartment is checked to operate normally.

items.title: No. 1 (STC ST01424LA, ST01457LA, and ST01804LA Only)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated cargo compartment remains empty.

items.title: No. 2 (Boeing installed system and STC ST01184LA Only)
items.rem: Except for ER operations, may be inoperative with cargo carried in compartment.

items.title: No. 2 (STC ST01424LA ST01457LA, and ST01804LA Only)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated cargo compartment remains empty.

items.title: No. LRD2 (STC ST00405LA-D Only)
items.rem: Except for ER operations, may be inoperative with cargo carried in compartment.

items.title: Squib Lights (STC ST01424LA, and ST01457LA Only)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated cargo compartment remains empty.

items.title: Boeing installed system, STC ST01184LA and ST00405LA-D Only
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated extinguisher bottle(s) is verified to have an adequate charge once each flight-day.

items.title: STC ST01424LA, ST01457LA, and ST01804LA Only
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated compartment remains empty.

items.title: Extinguisher Bottle Pressure Switch (Boeing installed system only)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated extinguisher bottle(s) is verified to have an adequate charge once each flight-day.

items.title: EXT Lights (FWD and AFT) (Boeing installed system, STC ST01184LA and ST00405LA-D Only)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Failure is verified to be in squib light circuit, and
b) Squib circuit is verified to operate normally once each flight-day.

items.title: Fault(s) Indicated by Illumination of MX Indicator (STC ST00511LA, ST00404LA-D, ST00740LA-D, ST00745LA-D, ST00751LA-D, and ST00990LA-D Only)
items.rem:
Dispatch with MX indicator illuminated is permitted provided green SYS OK indicator remains illuminated.
NOTE: This is a fault tolerant system and unit will continue to perform its intended function as long as green SYS OK indicator remains illuminated.

items.title: Display of FWD INOP and/or AFT INOP Message(s)
items.rem: May be displayed provided green SYS OK indicator remains illuminated and indicated cargo bay remains empty.

items.title: Smoke Detector(s)
items.rem:
One smoke detector may be inoperative in each compartment provided SYS OK indicator on CDU remains illuminated.
NOTE: MX indicator on CDU will remain illuminated.

items.title: Control Panel ALARM OFF Switch (STC ST00749LA-D and ST00763LA-D Only)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided Fire Bell cutout switch silences Cargo Bay Fire Protection Fire Warning Bell.

items.title: DET Lights (STC ST01674AT, and ST01114WI Only)
items.rem: One light in each compartment may be inoperative provided remaining loop in associated compartment is checked to operate normally before each departure.

items.title: FAIL Lights (STC ST01674AT, and ST01114WI Only)
items.rem: One light in each compartment may be inoperative provided remaining loop in associated compartment is checked to operate normally before each departure.

items.title: STC ST01674AT, and ST01114WI Only
items.rem: One detector in each detector enclosure may be inoperative provided remaining detector in associated detector enclosure is verified to operate normally before each departure.

items.title: Fault Panel (E and E Compartment, STCs ST01674AT, and ST01114WI Only)
DETECTOR FAULT Light (Boeing Installed System Only)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided the cargo fire TEST switch is used to check for faults in the cargo fire detection and suppression system before each flight.

items.title: Galley Fire Detection System (Jet Aviation Engineering Services (JAES))
items.rem: May be inoperative provided procedures are established and used to deactivate cooktop.

items.title: Galley Vent Fire Extinguisher System (STC ST09977)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided procedures are established and used to deactivate cooktop and vent fan.

items.title: Equipment Cabinets
items.rem: May be inoperative provided all equipment in cabinet is deactivated off.

items.title: Cabin Compartments
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated cabin compartment remains open and is continuously monitored.

items.title: Engine Start Lever Fire Indication Lights
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Engine No. 1 and Engine No. 2 fire handle switch lights function normally prior to engine start for each flight, and
b) Repairs are made within 3 flight-days.

items.title: Supernumerary and Lavatory Compartment Fire Detection/ Suppression Systems (STC ST02556SE)

items.rem: May be inoperative provided the supernumerary compartment is occupied during all phases of the flight.
May be inoperative while the supernumerary compartment is not occupied provided the flight deck door and the lavatory door remain opened and secured during all phases of the flight.

items.title: Supernumerary Compartment Smoke Detector
items.rem: May be inoperative while the supernumerary compartment is not occupied provided the flight deck door remains opened and secured during all phases of the flight.

items.title: Lavatory Smoke Detector
items.rem: May be inoperative while the supernumerary compartment is not occupied provided the flight deck door and the lavatory door remain opened and secured during all phases of the flight.

items.title: Wing Trailing Edge Flap Position Indication System
Leading Edge Flap/Slat Position Light Systems

items.rem: Aft overhead LE DEVICES Annunciator panel may be inoperative provided forward panel lights operate normally.

Forward panel lights may be inoperative provided:
a) Aft overhead LE DEVICES Annunciator panel operates normally and is used to verify proper LE DEVICE position, and
b) A placard is installed to indicate proper position for flap configuration in use.

items.title: Leading Edge Slat Indications (-800)
items.rem:
Indication lights on forward panel, and in addition, indication lights for one leading edge slat, except for slats 3, 4, 5, and 6, on overhead annunciator panel may be inoperative provided:
a) Normal operation is verified by flightcrew before each takeoff and landing,
b) Maximum speed is limited to 300 KIAS at/below FL 200 or .65 Mach above FL 200,
c) All remaining indications on overhead annunciator panel operate normally, and
d) Stall warning operation of both systems is verified to operate normally.

items.title: All Models Except -800 with Short Field Performance (SFP) Option and -900ER
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) System is deactivated,
b) Operations are conducted in accordance with AFM, and
c) For models with Blended Winglet or Split Scimitar Winglet with Speed Brake Load Alleviation System, Speed Brake Load Alleviation System is considered inoperative.
NOTE: Refer to MMEL Item 27-20 (Speedbrake Load Alleviation System)

items.title: -800 without Short Field Performance (SFP) Option
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Flaps are not extended beyond Flaps 30 at gross weights above 93,995 lbs. (42,635 kg), and
b) Flaps are not extended beyond Flaps 15 at gross weights above 104,875 lbs. (47,570 kg).

items.title: -800 with Short Field Performance (SFP) Option
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Flaps are not extended beyond Flaps 30 at gross weights above 95,800 lbs. (43,454 kg),
b) Flaps are not extended beyond Flaps 15 at gross weights above 105,000 lbs. (47,627 kg), and
c) Flaps are not extended beyond Flaps 10 at gross weights above 135,800 lbs. (61,597 kg).

items.title: FEEL DIFF PRESS Light System
items.rem: May be inoperative provided Elevator feel system is verified to operate normally once each flight-day.

items.title: Auto Slat Fail Light System (-300/-400/-500/-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Auto slat systems are verified to operate normally, and
b) Verification is repeated every 2 flight-days.

items.title: Auto Slat Systems (-300/-400/-500.-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
One system may be inoperative provided:
a) Remaining auto slat system is checked to operate normally, and
b) Auto Slat fail light operates normally.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Control Surface Position Indication System is installed and operates normally,
b) Rudder trim actuator is checked to operate normally, and
c) Rudder trim is checked to be centered before each departure.

items.title: (All Models, Upon Incorporation of Boeing Service Bulletin 737-27-1252, 737-27-1253, or 737-27-1255, or Production Equivalent)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Rudder trim actuator is checked to operate normally, and
b) Rudder trim is checked centered before each departure.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided speedbrakes are verified to operate normally.

items.title: -700/-800 with Blended Winglet or Split Scimitar Winglet STC ST00830SE

items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Speedbrake handle forces are normal from full down to full up position,
b) Airspeed does not exceed 265 KIAS when in-flight gross weight is in excess of 155,000 lbs. (70,306 kg),
c) Severe turbulent air penetration speed is 265 KIAS or 0.76 Mach, whichever is lower, when in-flight gross weight is in excess of 155,000 lbs. (70,306 kg), and
d) Automatic Speedbrake System is considered inoperative.
NOTE: Refer to MMEL Item 27-07 (Auto Speed Brake System).

May be inoperative provided:
a) Speedbrake handle forces are normal from full down to full up position, and
b) Takeoff weight does not exceed 155,500 lbs. (70,533 kg).

items.title: STBY RUD ON light (Boeing Service Bulletin 737-27A-1279, 737-27-1252R3, 737-27-1253R3, 737-27-1255R3, or Production Equivalent Incorporated)
items.rem:
May inoperative provided:
a) Rudder is verified to operate normally on hydraulic systems A and B independently,
b) Standby hydraulic pump is verified to operate normally, and
c) Rudder force fight monitor is deactivated.

items.title: Quiet Wing Flaps 1* System (STC ST01535SE Only)
Elevator Tab Control Springs (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
One may be broken or missing per elevator provided:
a) Broken spring is removed, and
b) Repairs are made within 10 flight-days.

items.title: Aft Pumps
items.rem:
Except for ER operations beyond 120 minutes, one may be inoperative provided:
a) Both main tank forward pumps operate normally,
b) At start of takeoff, fuel quantity in associated tank is not less than 7,500 lbs. (3,402 kg),
c) A minimum fuel quantity of 2,500 lbs. (1,134 kg) is maintained in associated tank, and
d) Boost pump is deactivated.

items.title: Forward Pumps
items.rem:
Except for ER operations beyond 120 minutes, one may be inoperative provided:
a) Both main tank aft pumps operate normally,
b) At start of takeoff, fuel quantity in associated tank is not less than 4,800 lbs. (2,177 kg),
c) A minimum fuel quantity of 1,800 lbs. (817 kg) is maintained in associated tank, and
d) Boost pump is deactivated.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Tank remains empty, and
b) Boost pump is deactivated.

May be inoperative with center tank fueled provided:
a) Fuel quantity remaining in main wing tanks is adequate to reach a suitable airport if remaining center pump fails at any time,
b) Zero fuel weight calculations are adjusted by weight of center tank fuel,
c) Effect on airplane balance, in event fuel cannot be used, is accounted for,
d) LOW PRESSURE light of operating center fuel tank pump operates normally,
e) Center tank quantity indication operates normally, and
f) Boost pump is deactivated.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Center tank quantity indication operates normally,
b) Center tank remains empty or zero fuel weight calculations are adjusted by weight of center tank fuel, and
c) Boost pump is deactivated.
NOTE: AFM fuel loading and usage limitations are for usable fuel.

items.title: Universal Fault Interrupter (UFI) (STC ST01844LA, -300, ST02076LA, -600/-700/-800/-900)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided associated center tank boost pump is considered inoperative.
NOTE: Refer to MMEL Item 28-02 (Fuel Boost Pumps (Center Tank)).

items.title: Fuel Boost Pump Low Pressure Warning Light Systems
Main Tank Pump Low Pressure Warning Light Systems
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Associated fuel pump is not used, and
b) MASTER CAUTION lights and FUEL system annunciator light are verified to operate normally.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Both pumps in associated tank operate normally, and
b) Associated tank quantity indicator operates normally.
May be inoperative for an associated inoperative pump.

items.title: Center Tank Pump Low Pressure Warning Light Systems

items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Associated fuel pump is not used, and
b) MASTER CAUTION lights and FUEL system annunciator light are verified to operate normally.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Center tank fuel is not required for flight,
b) Center tank fuel boost pumps are turned off, and
c) Center tank remains empty or zero fuel weight calculations are adjusted by weight of center tank fuel.

items.title: Center Tank Pump Lights
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Center Tank Fuel Quantity Indicator operates normally, and
b) MASTER CAUTION lights and FUEL system annunciator light are verified to operate normally.

items.title: APU Fuel Valve
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) APU is not used, and
b) Valve is deactivated closed.

items.title: Crossfeed VALVE OPEN Light
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) Crossfeed valve is verified to operate normally,
b) Fuel quantity indication for both main tanks operates normally.

items.title: Flight Deck Fuel Quantity Indicators (Main Tanks)
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, one may be inoperative provided:
a) All boost pumps in associated tank operate normally,
b) Fuel flow meters operate normally,
c) Center tank indicator operates normally,
d) Flightcrew periodically computes fuel remaining, or checks fuel remaining against a precomputed fuel burn chart, and
e) Fuel quantity in associated main tank is verified by an acceptable procedure.

items.title: Flight Deck Fuel Quantity Indicator (Center Tank)
(-100 and -600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) One center tank boost pump operates normally, and
b) Center tank remains empty.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER) (With Boeing Service Bulletin 737-28A1206 or Production Equivalent Installed)
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) Both center tank boost pumps operate normally, and
b) Fuel quantity in center tank is verified by an acceptable procedure.

items.title: Fuel Temperature Indicator
items.rem: May be inoperative provided Total Air Temperature or Ram Air Temperature is substituted as an indication of fuel temperature.

items.title: Pressure Fueling System
items.rem: May be inoperative provided alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Fueling Manifold Check Valves
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated Fueling Shutoff Valve is verified to operate normally.

items.title: Fueling Shutoff Valve
items.rem:
May be inoperative closed provided:
a) Verify the refuel valve is closed by pressurizing the fueling manifold and verify that fuel does not flow to the tank with the failed refuel valve, and
b) After removal of the fueling nozzle, check the fueling receptacle for leakage. Leakage is not allowed.

items.title: Refuel Panel Fueling Power Control Switch
items.rem: May be inoperative off provided refuel panel indicator test switch operates normally in AUX FUELING POWER CONTROL position or FUEL DOOR SWITCH BYPASS position as applicable.

items.title: Refueling Control Panel Quantity Indicators
items.rem: May be inoperative provided fuel quantity is verified by an acceptable procedure.

items.title: Aft Auxiliary Fuel Tank Boost Pumps (Boeing Aux Tank)

items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) Fuel quantity in other tanks is adequate to reach an alternate destination if remaining pump fails at any time, and
b) Fuel in tank is included as part of zero fuel weight.
May be inoperative provided tank remains empty.
May be inoperative provided fuel in tank is included as part of zero fuel weight.

items.title: Flight Deck Fuel Quantity Indicators (Aft Auxiliary Tank)
Boeing Tank Indicator (Boost Pump Transfer System)

items.rem: May be inoperative provided both boost pumps operate normally when tank is fueled.
May be inoperative provided tank remains empty.

May be inoperative provided:
a) Both auxiliary fuel transfer systems operate normally,
b) Flight deck center tank fuel quantity indicator operates normally,
c) Tank is emptied and serviced with a known quantity of fuel, and
d) AFM normal procedures are used for in-flight fuel transfer.
May be inoperative provided tank remains empty.

items.title: Fuel Measuring Sticks/Dripsticks
items.rem: May be inoperative or broken/missing provided fuel quantity is determined by other acceptable means.
May be inoperative with fuel scavenge shutoff valve closed.
May be inoperative with fuel scavenge shutoff valve open provided No. 1 Main Fuel Tank forward boost pump remains off.
May be inoperative with fuel scavenge shutoff valve open provided center tank remains empty.

items.title: Aft Auxiliary Tank Pressurized Transfer System (Rogerson/PATS Aux Tank)

items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) Remaining transfer system operates normally,
b) Fuel quantity in other tanks is adequate to reach an alternate destination if remaining valve fails at any time, and
c) Fuel in tank is included as part of zero fuel weight.
May be inoperative provided tank remains empty.
May be inoperative provided fuel in tank is included as part of zero fuel weight.

items.title: Aft Auxiliary Tank Refueling Valves (Rogerson Aux Tank)
items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) Remaining refueling valve operates normally, and
b) Automatic refueling shutoff system operates normally.

items.title: Aft Auxiliary Tank LOW PRESSURE TRANSFER Lights (Rogerson Aux Tank)

items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) Auxiliary fuel tank indicator operates normally, and
b) Automatic transfer system operates normally.
May be inoperative for an associated inoperative fuel transfer system.

items.title: SPAR VALVE CLOSED Lights (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Associated valve is verified to operate normally, and
b) Crossfeed VALVE OPEN light operates normally.

items.title: Center Tank Fuel Boost Pump Automatic Shutoff System (Service Bulletin 737-28A1228, 737-28A1216, 737-28A1206, or Equivalent Installed)

items.rem:
May be inoperative provided associated center tank fuel boost pump is considered inoperative.
NOTE: Refer to MMEL Item 28-02 (Fuel Boost Pumps (Center Tank)).
May be inoperative provided center tank remains empty.

items.title: -600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER
items.rem:
May be inoperative with center tank fueled provided:
a) Both center tank fuel boost pump Low Pressure Warning Light Systems operate normally,
b) Center tank fuel quantity indication operates normally,
c) Center tank fuel boost pumps must not be ON unless personnel are available in the flight deck to monitor low pressure lights,
d) For ground operations, center tank fuel boost pump switches must not be positioned to ON unless the center tank fuel quantity exceeds 1,000 lbs. (453 kg), except when defueling or transferring fuel,
e) Center tank fuel boost pumps are OFF for takeoff if center tank fuel is less than 5,000 lbs. (2,300 kg) with airplane readied for initial taxi,
f) Both center tank fuel boost pumps are selected OFF when center tank fuel quantity reaches 1,000 lbs. (453 kg) of fuel during climb and cruise,
g) Both center tank fuel boost pumps are selected OFF when center tank fuel quantity reaches 3,000 lbs. (1,400 kg) of fuel during descent and landing,
h) Both center tank fuel boost pumps are positioned OFF at first indication of fuel pump low pressure,
i) Center tank fuel boost pumps may be positioned ON when established in cruise flight if the center tank contains more than 1,000 lbs. (453 kg) of fuel,
j) If the main tanks are not full, the zero fuel gross weight of the airplane plus the weight of center tank fuel may exceed the maximum zero fuel weight by up to 5,000 lbs. (2,300 kg) for takeoff, climb, and cruise and up to 3,000 lbs. (1,400 kg) for descent and landing provided that the effects of balance (CG) have been considered, and
k) Defueling with passengers on board is prohibited.

items.title: Fuel Shutoff Valve Battery and Charger (-600/700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: May be inoperative deactivated.

items.title: Forward Auxiliary Fuel System Transfer Valves (PATS, -700/-800/-900ER)

items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) Inoperative FWD Aux tank transfer valve is verified "closed" and remains closed,
b) Remaining Fwd Aux tank transfer valve operates normally,

May be inoperative provided procedures do not require its use.

items.title: Nitrogen Generation System (NGS) (All Models)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) NGS shutoff valve is deactivated closed, and
b) Repairs are made within 10 flight-days.

items.title: Auxiliary Power Unit (APU)
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) Procedures do not require its use, and
b) Perform a visual inspection of the tail cone area and the adjacent control surfaces to confirm that there is no evidence of heat damage or delamination.

items.title: APU Annunciator LOW OIL PRESSURE and OVER SPEED Lights
items.rem: May be inoperative provided APU Auto Shutdown System operates normally.

items.title: APU Annunciator LOW OIL QUANTITY/MAINT Light
items.rem: May be inoperative and APU used provided oil quantity is checked once each flight-day.

items.title: Model GTCP85-129
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) All warning and caution lights operate normally,
b) APU is used to supply electrical power and for starting one engine only, and
c) Passengers are not permitted on board until APU has been shut down.
May be inoperative open.
Except for ER operations, may be inoperative in any other position if APU is not used.

May be inoperative closed.
NOTE: APU may be used to provide electrical power.

Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) APU bleed air check valve operates normally, and
b) APU is not operated.

May be inoperative in open position provided APU bleed air is not used.
NOTE: APU may be used to provide electrical power.
Except for ER operations, may be inoperative in closed position provided APU is not used.

items.title: APU Annunciator HIGH OIL TEMP/FAULT Light
Start Power Unit (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided procedures do not require use of APU.

items.title: Start Converter Unit (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided procedures do not require use of APU.

items.title: Voltage Regulator Function
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided APU generator is not used for electrical power.
NOTE: APU may be used as a pneumatic source.

items.title: Forward Air Stair
items.rem: NOTE: Any mode that operates normally may be used.

items.title: Entry/Service/Cargo/ Equipment/Airstair
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided associated door is verified closed and locked before each departure.
NOTE: On -600/-700/-800/-900/ -900ER, if two or more entry/service door warning lights are inoperative due to failed door sensors, overwing exit flight lock system and mid exit flight lock system (-900ER) will not function properly. Refer to item 52-15.

items.title: Overwing (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Associated door is verified closed and latched before each departure, and
b) Associated flight lock is verified to operate normally.

items.title: Left Main Cabin Door Pressure Stop Fittings
Aft Airstair Door and Forward Entry Door

items.rem:
One per door may be broken or missing provided:
a) There are no visible defects on other fittings for associated door,
b) Pressure differential does not exceed 6.0 psi, and
c) Analog cabin pressure control system standby control mode operates normally and STBY is used.

One per door may be broken or missing provided:
a) There are no visible defects on other fittings for associated door,
b) Pressure differential does not exceed 6.0 psi,
c) Digital cabin pressure control system AUTO or ALTN control mode operates normally, and
d) Alternate procedures are established and used.

One per door may be broken or missing provided:
a) There are no visible defects on other fittings for associated door,
b) Pressure differential does not exceed 3.4 psi, and
c) Analog cabin pressure control system standby control mode operates normally and STBY is used.

One per door may be broken or missing provided:
a) There are no visible defects on other fittings for associated door,
b) Pressure differential does not exceed 3.4 psi,
c) Digital cabin pressure control system AUTO or ALTN control mode operates normally, and
d) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Lower Cargo Doors Pressure Stop Fittings
(All Models)
items.rem:
Any one may be broken or missing on each door or frame provided:
a) No defects are visible on other fittings for associated door,
b) Cabin pressure controller AUTO mode operates normally,
c) Adjacent stop fittings are inspected within 25 flights, and
d) Not more than 50 flights are made before completion of repairs or replacements.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800 Prior to Incorporation of Boeing Service Bulletins 737-26-1121 and 737-26-1122, and either 737-21-1135 or 737-21-1163 or their Production Equivalents)
items.rem: Two may be broken or missing on each door or frame provided airplane is operated in an unpressurized configuration only.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800 All-Passenger Configuration Upon Incorporation of Boeing Service Bulletins 737-26-1121 and 737-26-1122, and either 737-21-1135 or 737-21-1163 or their Production Equivalents)
items.rem:
Two may be broken or missing on each door or frame provided:
a) Flight is conducted in an unpressurized configuration, and
b) Procedures are established and used to ensure lower forward cargo compartment remains empty or is verified to contain only empty cargo handling equipment, ballast (ballast may be loaded in ULDs), and/or Fly Away Kits.
NOTE: Operator MELs must define which items are approved for inclusion in Fly Away Kits and which materials can be used as ballast.

items.title: Entry/Service Door Hold- Open Latch Assemblies
items.rem: May be inoperative for all-cargo operations.

items.title: Flight Deck Door Lock System (Not 14 CFR Part 25, § 25.795 Compliant)

items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Door lock solenoid is deactivated in locked position, and
b) Door is verified to lock and unlock manually.
May be inoperative provided supplemental flight deck door security device is installed and operates normally.
May be inoperative provided all-cargo operations are being conducted.

items.title: Lower Cargo Doors Door Balance Mechanism
items.rem: May be inoperative provided a safety hold open device is used when door is in open position.

items.title: Main Cabin Cargo Door (PEMCO Aeroplex, Inc. STC SA2969SO)
Latch Pin, Latch Base, and Lower Jamb Latch Fitting
items.rem:
One may be broken or missing from main cargo door provided:
a) A visual check is made before departure to ensure no defects are visible on other latch bases, pins, or lower jamb latch fittings,
b) Latch pin and latch base of damaged latch does not interfere with continuous safe operation of remaining latches and pins,
c) Flight is conducted in an unpressurized configuration,
d) Procedures are established and used to ensure main and lower lobe cargo compartments remain empty or are verified to contain only empty cargo handling equipment, ballast (ballast may be loaded in ULDs), and/or Fly Away Kits, and
e) Repairs are made within 2 flight-days.
NOTE: Operator MELs must define which items are approved for inclusion in Fly Away Kits and which materials can be used as ballast.
One may be inoperative provided remaining latch cylinder is operative through gear box.
May be inoperative provided door may be latched and unlatched manually.

items.title: Hydraulic System Control Valve
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door may be locked and unlocked manually.

items.title: Lifting Actuator Assembly
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door is verified latched and locked.

items.title: Double Piloted Check Valve
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door may be locked and unlocked manually.

items.title: Lock, Lock Mount, and Locking Fittings
items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) No defects are visible on remaining lock or lock mount of associated door, and
b) Repairs are made within 2 flight-days.

items.title: Sequence Valves
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door is verified latched and locked.

items.title: Priority Valve
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door is verified latched and locked.

items.title: Hydraulic Lock Actuators
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door can be unlocked and unlatched manually.

items.title: Main Cargo Door Electrically Powered Hydraulic Pump (Standalone Hydraulic System Only) (PEMCO Aeroplex, Inc. STC SA2969SO)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door is closed, latched, and locked before each departure.

items.title: Hydroelectric and/or Manual Mode (STCs ST01566LA, ST00287AT, ST01827LA, ST01961SE, and ST02556SE)
items.rem: One may be inoperative provided remaining mode operates normally.

items.title: (STCs ST01566LA, ST01961SE, and ST02556SE)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door is verified closed, latched, and locked before each departure.

items.title: Lower Cargo Doors Hold Open Mechanism/Device

items.rem: May be inoperative provided Door Balance Mechanism operates normally.
May be inoperative provided cargo compartment remains empty.

items.title: Overwing Exit (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) For inoperative flight lock(s), inputs to associated flight deck indications are deactivated,
b) Each affected exit is verified to be capable of being unlatched and opened before each departure, and
c) A person employed by operator is designated to remain seated in passenger seat nearest affected exit when cabin differential pressure is less than 4.0 psi.

items.title: Boeing/C&D Aerospace Enhanced Flight Deck Security Door Automatic Locking System (14 CFR Part 25, § 25.795 Compliant)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Automatic locking system is deactivated,
b) Door dead bolt operates normally and is used to lock door, and
c) Alternate procedures are established and used for locking and unlocking door using dead bolt.

items.title: Flight Deck Access Panel System (Keypad, Door Chime)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Keypad is deactivated, and
b) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: LEDs
items.rem: May be inoperative provided alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Door Bell Mode
items.rem: May be inoperative provided alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Switch Guard
items.rem: May be inoperative or missing provided flight deck door LOCK FAIL light operates normally.

items.title: Flight Deck Door LOCK FAIL Light
items.rem: May be inoperative provided automatic lock controls are verified to operate normally.

items.title: Flight Deck Door AUTO UNLK Light
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Automatic lock controls are verified to operate normally, and
b) Door chime operates normally.

items.title: Fight Deck Door Lock Control Selector
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Keypad is deactivated,
b) Automatic lock is verified to operate normally, and
c) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Boeing/C&D Aerospace Enhanced Flight Deck Security Door Dead Bolt (14 CFR Part 25, § 25.795 Compliant)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided automatic lock controls operate normally.

items.title: JAMCO Flight Deck Security Door Automatic Locking System (14 CFR Part 25, § 25.795 Compliant)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Automatic locking system is deactivated,
b) Mechanical Catch (Latch) Pin operates normally and is used to lock door, and
c) Alternate procedures are established and used for locking and unlocking flight deck door using Mechanical Catch (Latch) Pin.

items.title: Door Automatic Locking Solenoid
items.rem: One may be inoperative provided remaining locking solenoid operates normally.

items.title: Speakers
items.rem: One may be inoperative provided remaining speaker is verified to operate normally once each flight-day.

items.title: Aural Warning System
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) AUTO UNLK Light is verified to operate normally, and
b) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Door LOCK FAIL Light
items.rem: May be inoperative OFF provided automatic lock controls are verified to operate normally.

items.title: Door AUTO UNLK Light
items.rem:
May be inoperative OFF provided:
a) Automatic lock controls are verified to operate normally,
b) Aural Warning system operates normally, and
c) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Door HARD LOCK Light
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Automatic lock controls are verified to operate normally, and
b) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Door UNLKD Switch/UNLK Switch Position
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Door can be opened manually from flight deck,
b) Remaining automatic lock controls are verified to operate normally, and
c) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Door UNLKD Light
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Automatic lock controls are verified to operate normally, and
b) Aural warning system operates normally.

items.title: Door EMRG ENTRY ACTIVE Light
items.rem: May be inoperative provided door aural warning system is verified to operate normally.

items.title: Door OPEN Light
items.rem: May be inoperative provided Automatic Lock controls are verified to operate normally.

items.title: Cabin Pushbutton Entry Pad/Keypad
items.rem: May be inoperative provided alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Keypad Indicator Lights
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Keypad is verified to operate normally, and
b) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Flight Deck Door Pressure Relief Panels
JAMCO Flight Deck Security Door Pressure Relief Latches (14 CFR Part 25, § 25.795 Compliant)
items.rem: May be inoperative in latched position provided repairs are made within 2 flight-days.

items.title: Boeing/C&D Aerospace Enhanced Flight Deck Security Door (14 CFR Part 25, § 25.795 Compliant)
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Panels are in latched position, and
b) Repairs are made within 2 flight-days.

items.title: JAMCO Flight Deck Security Door Mechanical Catch Pin Lock (14 CFR Part 25, § 25.795 Compliant)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided automatic lock system is verified to operate normally.

items.title: Flight Deck Door Hold Open Device (e.g., Door Stop, Foot Plunger)

items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Alternate procedures are established and used, and
b) Repairs are made within 3 flight-days.

May be inoperative provided:
a) An electronic flight deck door visual surveillance system is installed and operates normally, and
b) Alternate procedures are established and used.

items.title: Main Cabin Cargo Door Vent Door
Cargo Door Exterior Handle Recess/Hinge Spring Assemblies
items.rem: May be inoperative or missing provided the affected cargo door exterior handle is secured in a recessed position flush with the fuselage.

items.title: Fuel Filter Differential Pressure Warning Systems
(-300/-400/-500/-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided malfunction is verified to be in warning system.

items.title: Fuel Flow Indication Systems
items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) N1, N2 for associated engine operate normally, and
b) Both main tank fuel quantity indicators operate normally.

items.title: Fuel Control ENG VALVE CLOSED Indicating System (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided associated valve is verified to operate normally.

items.title: Normal (ON) Mode
items.rem:
May be inoperative provided:
a) Both engines are operated in ALTERNATE mode,
b) Strut/Wing leading edge over-braided wire bundles are installed per Boeing Service Bulletin or production equivalent, and
c) Applicable AFM performance adjustments are applied.

items.title: Electronic Engine Control (EEC) Alternate Power Supply System (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: May be inoperative deactivated provided repairs are made in accordance with the times established in Boeing Maintenance Planning Data document, D626A001, Section 1, items 73-020-01 and 73-020-02.

One may be inoperative provided:
a) Ignition Select Switch remains in BOTH position, and
b) Right ignition systems operate normally.

Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) Ignition Select Switch remains in BOTH position, and
b) Associated engine right ignition system operates normally.

One may be inoperative provided:
a) Ignition Select Switch remains in BOTH position,
b) Left ignition systems operate normally, and
c) Associated engine left igniter is connected to AC Standby Bus by an acceptable configuration.

Except for ER operations, may be inoperative provided:
a) Ignition Select Switch remains in BOTH position,
b) Associated engine left ignition systems operate normally, and
c) Associated engine left igniter is connected to AC Standby Bus by an acceptable configuration.

items.title: Digital Counters
items.rem:
Except for EIS/CDS equipped airplanes, may be inoperative provided autothrottle is used for takeoff thrust setting.
NOTE: An indicator with an operating pointer is considered to operate normally.

items.title: Digital Counters
items.rem:
May be inoperative except for EIS/CDS equipped airplanes.
NOTE: An indicator with an operating pointer is considered to operate normally.

items.title: Digital Counters
items.rem: May be inoperative except for EIS/CDS equipped airplanes.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) Thrust reverser is locked in forward thrust position, and
b) Appropriate performance adjustments are applied.

items.title: REVERSER Lights (Aft Overhead Panel) (-300/-400/-500/-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: One may be inoperative provided associated reverser is locked in closed (forward thrust) position.

items.title: Oil Quantity Indication Systems
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, one may be inoperative provided:
a) Oil tank is filled to maximum recommended capacity at each refueling,
b) There is no evidence of above normal oil consumption or leakage, and
c) Associated low oil pressure warning system operates normally.

items.title: (-100/-200/-300/-400/-500/-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) Malfunction is in warning system, and
b) Oil filter is inspected for presence of contaminants once each flight-day.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
One may be inoperative provided:
a) Malfunction is in the warning system,
b) All three Magnetic Chip Detectors are inspected for presence of contaminants once each flight-day, and
c) Oil supply filter pop-out indicator is confirmed not extended once each flight-day.

items.title: Oil Low Pressure Warning Systems
items.rem: May be inoperative provide associated oil pressure, oil temperature, and oil quantity indicators operates normally.

items.title: (-300/-400/-500/-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: One may be inoperative provided it is checked after engine start that associated valve is closed.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem: May be inoperative provided flightcrew manually selects Start Switch OFF or AUTO at 55% N2.

items.title: (-600/-700/-800/-900/-900ER)
items.rem:
Except for ER operations, one may be inoperative provided:
a) Associated start valve indication operates normally, and
b) Manual override start procedures are used.
